description: Create + fund an escrow to another Spawnpay agent. Locks USDC from your balance until you release or refund. Use for conditional payments: agent A pays agent B only after B delivers work. Internal-only (payee must be a Spawnpay agent).

amount.description: USDC amount to lock in escrow

payee.description: Recipient: SP_xxx referral code or 0x... wallet address of another Spawnpay agent

terms.description: Optional plain-text terms describing what the payee must deliver

name: spawnpay_escrow_open
